channel.title: Bellwether — pricing changes
channel.description: Confirmed SaaS pricing changes tracked by Bellwether.

item.title: Postman Team tier added
item.description: Postman added a Team tier at $19/mo per seat, matching the removed Basic tier's price. — Likely the direct successor to Basic, keeping entry per-seat pricing flat while restructuring tier names and features.

item.title: Postman Solo tier added
item.description: Postman added a new Solo tier at $9/mo flat for 1 seat. — Provides a cheaper single-user paid option below the old Basic price point.

item.title: Postman Professional tier removed
item.description: Postman removed its $39/mo Professional tier with no like-for-like replacement announced. — Customers needing Professional-level features must now jump to Team at $19/mo (fewer features) or negotiate enterprise pricing, a potential feature/price gap.

item.title: Postman Basic tier removed
item.description: Postman removed its $19/mo Basic tier. — Existing Basic customers must move to a different plan; the identically priced Team tier ([11]) appears to be the direct replacement.

item.title: Postman Free seats changed
item.description: Postman's Free tier seat cap was cut further from 3 to 1. — Free tier is now effectively single-user only, a second tightening within roughly eight months (see also [2]).

item.title: Linear Business 14 to 16
item.description: Linear's Business tier rose from $14 to $16/mo, a 14% increase, same day as the Basic hike. — Linear raised prices across two tiers simultaneously, suggesting a company-wide pricing update rather than a single-tier adjustment.

item.title: Linear Basic 8 to 10
item.description: Linear's Basic tier rose from $8 to $10/mo, a 25% increase. — Entry-level Linear customers pay $24/yr more per seat.

item.title: Notion Notion AI tier removed
item.description: The Notion AI add-on tier (added in May) was removed four months later. — AI capability was likely folded into other paid plans rather than sold separately; buyers should check if AI is now bundled or gone.

item.title: Notion Free billing unit changed
item.description: Notion's Free tier switched from flat pricing to per-seat billing. — Free tier cost now scales with team size rather than being a single flat allowance.

item.title: Postman Free seats changed
item.description: Postman's Free tier gained an explicit seat cap of 3, where none was specified before. — Small teams relying on unlimited free seats now hit a hard limit and may need to upgrade.

item.title: Notion Business 15 to 20
item.description: Notion's Business tier rose from $15 to $20/mo per seat, a 33% increase. — Teams on Business pay $5 more per seat monthly; a 20-seat team now costs $1,200/yr more.

item.title: Notion Notion AI tier added
item.description: Notion introduced a standalone 'Notion AI' add-on tier at $10/mo ($8/mo billed annually), per seat. — Buyers could add AI features without upgrading their base plan, but at extra per-seat cost.
